rules.label: Distant in-person follow-up
rules.description: Routine outpatient/lab visits in the Follow-up phase add travel burden for patients far from a Center of Excellence.

suggested_mods.label: Permit home-health draw for routine labs at this visit
suggested_mods.rationale: Removes a round-trip to the CoE for a routine assessment with no procedure-specific staffing requirement.

suggested_mods.label: Mark this visit telehealth-eligible where clinically safe
suggested_mods.rationale: Vital-signs + PROs + symptom check can be handled by video; only labs need a local draw.

rules.label: Tight window with low travel slack
rules.description: Adjacent timepoints with ±1-day windows leave no recovery space for patients with low work/caregiving flexibility.

suggested_mods.label: Widen the visit window to ±3 days
suggested_mods.rationale: Lets the visit shift onto a non-workday without protocol deviation.

rules.label: Inpatient stay without reliable caregiver
rules.description: Multi-day inpatient hospitalization assumes a discharge partner who can stay nearby and manage logistics.

suggested_mods.label: Offer a documented caregiver-travel + lodging stipend
suggested_mods.rationale: Recruits a partner who otherwise can't take time off; commonly cited blocker in the LN community thread.

suggested_mods.label: Permit extended inpatient stay for patients without home support
suggested_mods.rationale: Removes the silent eligibility filter where 'no caregiver' equals 'not eligible'.

rules.label: Specialist imaging when patient is far from site
rules.description: Imaging that requires the trial site's equipment/reader is hard to substitute when the patient lives a long distance away.

suggested_mods.label: Allow local imaging acquisition with central read
suggested_mods.rationale: Echocardiograms are highly standardizable; central read preserves data quality while removing travel.

rules.label: 24-hour urine collection conflicts with work schedule
rules.description: A 24-hour collection requires a continuous at-home window; patients with low work flexibility either skip days or burn PTO.

suggested_mods.label: Document weekend-collection as the default option
suggested_mods.rationale: Lets the collection fall on non-working days for the majority of US patients.

rules.label: Fasting blood chemistry forced into morning slot
rules.description: Fasting requirements push the visit into an early-morning slot that's hardest for low-flexibility patients.

suggested_mods.label: Permit afternoon fasting draws (8-hour fast, evening cut-off)
suggested_mods.rationale: Removes the dawn-arrival expectation that drives missed visits.

rules.label: Procedure requires caregiver and persona lacks one
rules.description: Procedures flagged caregiver_required exclude patients without a reliable discharge partner.

suggested_mods.label: Offer a site-arranged non-medical companion for these visits
suggested_mods.rationale: Several sponsors now contract trained patient-companion services for sedation discharge; standard at oncology CoEs.

rules.label: Repeated ICE testing on top of cognitive fatigue
rules.description: ICE assessments at D7/D21/D28 plus daily during hospitalization compound for patients already self-reporting cognitive burden.

suggested_mods.label: Use a brief screening ICE; reserve full assessment for symptomatic patients
suggested_mods.rationale: Footnote i already gates ICE on CRS/ICANS symptoms during hospitalization — extend that gate to follow-up timepoints.

rules.label: Monthly pregnancy testing during long-tail follow-up
rules.description: Repeat in-clinic serum pregnancy tests through M3 and the M6-24 sweeps add visits for patients who otherwise wouldn't be at the site.

suggested_mods.label: Permit home urine hCG testing for the M6-M24 sweeps where the regulator allows
suggested_mods.rationale: Serum confirms only if positive; saves the in-clinic visit for the negative majority.

rules.label: Renal biopsy on top of prior treatment burden
rules.description: Screening renal biopsy is invasive and adds risk for patients who've already cycled through multiple therapies.

suggested_mods.label: Accept biopsy performed within the past 6 months
suggested_mods.rationale: Reduces invasive screening burden for refractory patients who likely have a recent biopsy on file.
